messages:
Leah: Quick heads-up — planning a short CRM curation sweep at 09:00 PT today. Goal: reconcile onboarding flags (trial_active vs onboarded), fix a small set of stale account-level tags, and suppress noisy playbook triggers that have been firing for already-renewed accounts. ETA ~1h, small batches.
Omar: Scope? Will this write to production records or just tagging preview?
Leah: This will write to prod — only tag/flag updates (no deletes). We'll gate by a low-volume sampler and run per-customer-owner batches. Playbook suppression will be temporary per-org.
Jules: Can you paste the query you plan to run so I can sanity-check join churn?
Leah: Yep — basic mismatch query below:
```sql
-- find accounts with trial_active=true but last_onboard_event >= 30_days ago
SELECT account_id, owner_id, trial_active, last_onboard_event
FROM accounts
WHERE trial_active = true
  AND last_onboard_event IS NOT NULL
  AND last_onboard_event < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND account_status = 'active'
LIMIT 1000;
```
Jules: Looks good. How are we preventing playbook double-fires?
Leah: We'll add a temporary filter: skip playbook if `renewal_status = 'renewed' OR manual_onboard_override = true`. Small change to the playbook condition flagged in the automations service:
```yaml
if: not (account.renewal_status == 'renewed' or account.manual_onboard_override == true)
then: run_onboard_playbook()
```
Ravi: Can you create a rollback plan? If tags get noisy we need to undo.
Leah: Rollback plan: we snapshot the changed rows to `cs_admin.backups_{ts}` and will apply reverse updates via the backup table. Also keeping a changelog in the admin bucket.
cs-bot: Task created — CS-8347: "CRM curation sweep — onboarding flags" assigned to Leah. ETA 1h.
Omar: Suggest adding a short suppression window on the playbook runner while we do the sweep (so no mid-sweep webhooks trigger external systems). Happy to flip it on for 09:00-10:30 PT. @Leah want me to do that?
Leah: Please do @Omar — enable suppression window 09:00-10:30 PT, then revert. I'll post start/finish updates here. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: I'll watch metrics — seats, playbook fire-rate, and any spike in support tickets. Ping if you need immediate rollback.
Leah: Thanks all. Kicking off in ~10min. Will post a short summary when first batch finishes.
